title: Jacobs' 'personal project hybrids'
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Jacobs' 'personal project hybrids', about c. 2016 and earlier at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So he described this as personal project hybrids because the grays have been trying to perfect a hybrid

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes the work of David Jacobs, a researcher of alien abduction reports and author of a book called Walking Among Us. According to Alberino, Jacobs described what he called "personal project hybrids", part-human, part-alien beings, and said the grays, the small grey-skinned beings of many abduction accounts, have been trying to perfect such a hybrid. If true, it would mean the abductions serve a breeding program.
